body:
Interesting bit:
[com.google.devtools.build.lib.analysis.RuleConfiguredTargetBuilder.addOutputGroup(RuleConfiguredTargetBuilder.java:388)](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/c4e92b1ba06fba48121e4db8050a69b6d998e2e9/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/analysis/RuleConfiguredTargetBuilder.java#L388) is not a place that can throw an NPE, maybe the test is wrong?

(confirmed that the distfile has indeed the same source)

How can a 'return this;' throw an NPE???

The second NPE is on a } statement, I would sya the -c opt mess up the stack information, cannot believe it.

See https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/ec5837de94117515d89c5f172d73b4f9a5fc8a36/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/analysis/constraints/ConstraintSemantics.java#L229
Ok this is not during bootstrapping but building the example

The test is doing:

```sh
export EXTRA_BAZEL_ARGS= "--spawn_strategy=standalone --genrule_strategy=standalone -c opt"
/opt/workspace/compile.sh && ./output/bazel test ${EXTRA_BAZEL_ARGS} //examples/cpp:hello-success_test
```

So let summarize:
C++ compilation with -c opt sometime fails with NPE on debian stretch during loading of C++ toolchain. The NPE stack is corrupted probably because of the -c opt (why would that be I have no idea).

The first one of the NPE is totally impossible in that function to I think the stack trace is wrong
Ok I am out of idea so delegating to marcel for further investigation.

Repro instruction: `bazel test //tools/cpp/test:test_cc_configure-debian-stretch-dbg`

This requires to have docker installed and to be in the docker group.

Now getting a shell on the docker image that is created by that test:
1. Comment line [153 of tools/cpp/test/docker_test.py](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/master/tools/cpp/test/docker_test.py#L153) (side-note: maybe we should add a flag to not cleanup after the test)
2. Run the test `bazel test //tools/cpp/test:test_cc_configure-debian-stretch-dbg`
3. Spawn a new docker container and attach a shell: `docker run -t -i --entrypoint /bin/bash bazel/docker_test:tools_cpp_test_bazel_cc_configure-debian-stretch-dbg`
Just FYI: I wasn't able to reproduce the exception, will look into it after I come back from vacation.
pinging this bug because it happened again today
